name: defuddle
title_zh: 网页正文提取器，去导航去广告只留干净文本
tagline_zh: 读文档、看文章、分析链接时，不再被侧栏和弹窗喂给大模型。Defuddle 本地解析，省 token 省到能多问三轮。
tagline_en: When reading docs or articles, stop feeding nav & popups to the LLM. Defuddle parses locally, saving tokens for.
desc_en: Extract clean markdown content from web pages using Defuddle CLI, removing clutter and navigation to save tokens. Use instead of WebFetch when the user provides a URL to read or analyze, for online documentation, articles, blog posts, or any standard web page.
why_zh: 不是简单抓 HTML 再剪——它按语义树识别主内容，连评论区、页脚、相关推荐都认得出来。
why_en: Not regex scraping—it walks the semantic tree to isolate the main article, recognizing comments, footers, and related links.
limit_zh: 只认标准 HTML 网页，不处理登录墙、JS 动态渲染或 PDF；输出纯 Markdown，图片只留链接。
limit_en: Standard HTML only—no login walls, JS-rendered pages, or PDFs. Output is plain Markdown; images become links; layout and interactivity are lost.
title_en: Extract clean web text, strip nav & ads
